note: Separate indicator variants; do not rewrite the original preregistered intrabar touch model as if equivalent. High-confluence checklist is not a probability estimate.

variants.A: Closed-bar first overlap episode, signal close reference, not a limit fill.
variants.B: Strictly later directional or reclaim confirmation within 3 bars; signal close reference.
variants.context: Default local structure plus optional completed HTF structure/EMA gate.
variants.session: Chart market open by default via feed-defined session.ismarket; not a custom liquidity-hours detector.
variants.profile: Prior-bars OHLCV candle-range volume allocation proxy for POC/VA; not built-in lower-timeframe profile data.
variants.confluence: Seven-point descriptive checklist (HTF, local structure, B confirmation, POC side, value-area side, EMA alignment, relative volume); threshold 5/7 by default; uncalibrated and not predictive probability.

baseline_testing: Milestone C only, after actual TradingView compile/replay
input_recording: Use TradingView input snapshot and script SHA256 in research/pine_validation_runs.csv; config.json does not configure a standalone Pine script.
